hero.title: Less Talk. More Action.
hero.intro: PHM Consulting helps organizations improve performance, strengthen teams and turn strategy into action.

statement: When progress stalls, decisions get delayed or teams struggle to move forward, PHM Consulting brings the structure, expertise and practical support needed to create momentum.

items.title: Decisive Execution
items.text: Turn priorities into practical action with clear responsibilities, workable plans and measures that show progress.

items.title: Empowered Culture
items.text: Build shared ownership, strengthen leadership and give teams the clarity and support they need to perform.

items.title: Iterative Innovation
items.text: Make practical improvements that fit available resources, learn from what works and build momentum over time.

connect.heading: Let’s Connect
connect.text: Tell us what your organization is working through and what you'd like to improve. We'll use your intake form to prepare for a focused first conversation.
